Triage: lands in `domain:devx` (`scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`); rationale: class (b) — **the gate's verdict over-claims its own scope.** A package joins `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` because its frozen factories were swept to zero and the gate now holds it there; that guarantee silently does not extend to the package's own subpaths, while the verdict line reads as a claim about the package. The card's own option 3 concedes exactly this ("record the boundary explicitly so the verdict line is not read as a claim about subpaths"). A green that asserts more than it checked is the defect. `Bug`.

⭐ **The admission boundary here is worth writing down, because this seat closed a neighbouring card today and the two must not be confused.** objectui#8286 (`check:comment-mask-corpus` runs on no PR, FABRICATES = 0) was closed as out-of-class; this one is admitted. The line:

> **No gate runs at all** ⇒ the absence is visible to anyone who looks; nothing is claimed, so nothing is over-claimed. Out of class until a defect appears.
> **A gate runs and reports a verdict broader than what it checked** ⇒ the absence is *hidden behind a green*. In class, because the green is the misinformation.

⇒ ⛔ Do not read this grade as "unenforced things are cards". It is the over-claim that is admitted, not the gap.

`priority:p3`: the current population is 2 subpath sites (`@object-ui/components/ui/sonner`, both in `plugin-form`) and **both already inherit**, so nothing is broken today — measured by running the gate's own exported `scan()`, which is the right instrument rather than a grep. The cost is prospective and the fix is free at today's numbers.

⭐ The card is right that this is **not an exemption and not a recogniser bug** — the resolver does exactly what it says. That framing is why it grades as a scope defect rather than a gate bug, and it should survive into the PR description.

Route: **option 1 (prefix match)** is the graded default — it is the only one that closes the class rather than the two instances, and the "tree is at zero, so the gate starts as a ratchet" argument that scoped #6849 applies unchanged. ⚠️ Its one precondition is on the card and must not be skipped: **re-measure the population first**, because a subpath can have a genuinely different export surface from its package root, and a prefix match would newly judge sites that were never swept. If that re-measure turns up frozen subpath factories, they are swept before the prefix match lands, ⛔ not floored into an exemption. Option 2 keeps the "a member joins only by sweep" invariant literally true but reopens the gap per subpath forever; ⛔ option 3 alone is not sufficient — documenting an over-claiming verdict does not stop it over-claiming.

⛔ Out of scope: #8117 is a different pin-versus-prose issue in the same file — ⛔ do not fold it in.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.

**What landed.** A member of `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` now covers `member` and `member/…`. The constant is unchanged at 18 and still names package ROOTS only — what widened is the *reach* of a membership, not the test for membership, so "a member joins only by sweep" survives literally. The verdict line reads `… and their subpaths judged`, so it is true of what the run checked, and the header carries the boundary, the re-measurement, and the sweep-not-floor rule for any future frozen subpath. Re-measured on today's 18 members (⛔ not on this card's own table from `214d5d5a6`): **623 → 625 judged, 37 → 35 other workspace, 0 frozen either way**, the two newly-judged sites both already inheriting — so it landed as a ratchet and no sweep was owed.

⭐ **The review's own finding, worth keeping on the card because it is the thing most likely to be broken by a future edit.** The PR and its pin justify including the `/` in the prefix with `@object-ui/react-native`, which does not exist. A package that *does* exist is **`@object-ui/react-runtime`** — enumerated here from all 39 `@object-ui/*` workspace manifests, it is the single bare string-prefix extension of a member (`@object-ui/react`) in the tree. A naive `startsWith(member)` would have pulled a real, never-swept package into `covered` and judged it as though it had been — the same over-claim this card removes, reintroduced one level up by its own fix. Re-checked on the merged tree: still a package, still not a member. ⇒ **If that pin is ever edited, `@object-ui/react-runtime` is the case that must keep passing.**

⭐ And the ablation is what earns the whole thing: with the resolver reverted, **the pins go red while the gate itself still exits 0**, printing `37 other workspace`. The gate cannot detect its own over-claim — the pin is the only thing between this and a green that asserts more than it checked.

**Downstream, now unblocked:** #8183 (`holdsObtainedModule()`) was serialised behind this card on the same file and may now be dispatched, rebasing onto this resolver rather than racing it. #6892's `@object-ui/app-shell` slice is queued behind it on the same file. ⛔ #8117 was not folded in and remains open on its own merits; #8392 records the workflow step comment this change makes stale, filed rather than fixed because it is one file outside the fence.

The `pm:*` state label is stripped in the same stroke; `domain:devx`, `tests`, `tooling` and `priority:p3` stay — attribution is not state.
